user.title: Configure Igor
user.description: Enter the URL of your self-hosted Igor API server.

data_description.api_token: Required when the Igor server has API authentication enabled.
data_description.user_id: The name of the memory Igor keeps for your household. Leave it as 'default'. You can change it later, and choose whether everyone shares one memory, under Configure.

hassio_confirm.title: Igor Detected
hassio_confirm.description: The Igor add-on has been detected. Would you like to set it up?

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Igor API. Make sure it's running and accessible.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid API token. Check your token on the Igor dashboard.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Igor add-on. Make sure it's running.

init.title: Igor
init.description: Choose whether everyone in your home shares one memory with Igor, and whether voice requests can be shown on a wall tablet. Security: the key that unlocks the screens and Igor, the alarm, and its disarm code.

data.allowed_users: Still answered while the key is away

data_description.shared_memory: On (recommended): everyone shares one memory, so something you tell a voice satellite is also known in the app and on the dashboard, and the other way round. Off: each Home Assistant user gets a memory of their own, and voice satellites and automations use the memory named below.
data_description.user_id: The memory Igor uses for the whole household, or, with shared memory off, for voice satellites and automations. Leave it as 'default' unless you have a reason to change it.
data_description.voice_display: On: the 'Igor Assist' sensor follows each voice-satellite request (question, answer, actions), and devices you switch on show it full screen, by opening Home Assistant once with ?igor_tablet=1 at the end of the address. The texts are not kept in the history. Off: no sensor, nothing is shown.
data_description.key_entity: A binary sensor that is on while the key is there (a USB key's presence). Off, unknown or unavailable: the screens lock and Igor refuses every request.
data_description.alarm_entity: What arms the alarm: an input_boolean, a switch or an alarm panel. The disarm code turns it off.
data_description.alarm_active_entity: A binary sensor that is on while the alarm is going off: the screens show the alert.
data_description.new_disarm_code: Digits only, at least 4. Only a salted hash is kept, never the code. Leave empty to keep the current code.
data_description.traffic_key: Optional. Shows traffic, closed roads and incidents on the wall's GPS card (a free key from developer.tomtom.com). Kept in Home Assistant only, never sent to a dashboard. Leave empty to keep the current key; a single dash (-) removes it.
data_description.allowed_users: Home Assistant users Igor still answers while the key is unplugged (the car's account, your phone). Never a voice satellite or an automation: they have no user.
data_description.car_tracker: The car's device_tracker (the head unit's companion app or GPSLogger). With the destination below, Igor can guide the car (« emmène-moi à la maison »), find a fuel station on the way and add it as a stop.
data_description.car_destination: The input_text the GPS card guides to (its `destination:`), such as input_text.voiture_destination, 120 characters.
data_description.car_users: Users who may use the car's services without being administrators: live traffic, routes, the GPS guidance Igor drives. Pick the head unit's account. Everything else stays for administrators.

error.bad_code: The code must be at least 4 digits.

confirm.title: Restart required
confirm.description: Home Assistant needs a restart to finish updating Igor ({running_version} → {installed_version}). Click Submit to restart Home Assistant now — or close this and restart later, at a moment that suits you. Igor keeps working in the meantime.

heard.name: Heard
heard.description: Tells the wall tablet that Igor heard its name, before the request itself arrives. Called by a listener such as igor-ear.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: The voice satellite the request is for. The tablet set to one satellite shows only its requests.

waiting.name: Waiting
waiting.description: The request is still to come: the name came alone, or Igor asked a question and listens for the answer.

seconds.name: Seconds
seconds.description: How long the tablet shows that Igor is listening, if nothing follows. Default 30.

journal.name: Journal
journal.description: Igor's last spoken exchanges with their steps, for the wall tablet's history. Returns them to the caller.

limit.name: Count
limit.description: How many exchanges, the newest ones.

listen.name: Listen
listen.description: Asks the ear in the room (igor-ear) to say « Je vous écoute » and take the next sentence as a request, through its own microphone. What the wall's « parler » button calls.

satellite.name: Satellite
satellite.description: The voice satellite whose ear should listen. Empty: every ear.

screen.name: Desk screen
screen.description: Orders for the desk screen shared with a PC (igor-ear's screen service): show the PC or the dashboard, sleep, wake, or open a settings window over the dashboard.

action.name: Action
action.description: pc, dashboard, off (sleep), on, toggle, app (open a settings window) or close (close them).

app.name: Settings window
app.description: With app: sound (pavucontrol), equalizer (EasyEffects) or bluetooth (Blueman).

disarm.name: Disarm
disarm.description: Turns the alarm off with its code. Five wrong codes in ten minutes refuse every try for ten minutes.

dns_log.name: DNS log
dns_log.description: AdGuard Home's newest DNS queries, for the live DNS card. Administrators only; nothing is kept.

limit.name: Count
limit.description: How many queries, the newest ones.

search.name: Search
search.description: Only the queries whose domain or client contains this text.

dns_map.name: DNS map
dns_map.description: Where the DNS answers of the last minutes point to, per country and operator, for the world map card. Administrators only.

wifi_clients.name: Wi-Fi clients
wifi_clients.description: Who is on which Wi-Fi, read from the OpenWrt access points listed under openwrt: in the nives: block. Administrators only.

net_map.name: Network map
net_map.description: Who talks to whom through the router, read from the OPNsense of the nives: block, with internet addresses grouped by operator. Administrators only.

wifi_scan.name: Wi-Fi scan
wifi_scan.description: The Wi-Fi networks around, heard by the OpenWrt access points (a radio may pause a second or two). Administrators only.

unlock_screen.name: Unlock a screen
unlock_screen.description: Turns a screen's maintenance lock (an input_boolean) off with the disarm code. Shares the alarm's lockout: five wrong codes in ten minutes refuse every try for ten minutes.

entity_id.name: Maintenance switch
entity_id.description: The input_boolean that locks the screen.

notifications.name: Notifications
notifications.description: The notifications Home Assistant sent (notify and Telegram), the newest first, for a dashboard card. Administrators only. Returns them to the caller.

limit.name: Count
limit.description: How many notifications, the newest ones.

trip_map.name: Trip map
trip_map.description: A device tracker's way between two times, drawn on a map and written to the media folder (igor/<name>.png) for telegram_bot.send_photo. Administrators only. Returns the file's path, the number of positions and the distance.

entity_id.name: Tracker
entity_id.description: The device_tracker whose history is drawn.

start.name: Start
start.description: The trip's start (default: two hours before the end).

name.name: File name
name.description: The picture's name in the media folder's igor folder.

traffic.name: Traffic
traffic.description: Traffic incidents (closed roads, roadworks, accidents, jams) around a point, from TomTom, for the GPS card. Needs a TomTom key in Igor's options; without one it answers enabled: false. Administrators only. Returns them to the caller.

radius_km.name: Radius
radius_km.description: How far around the point, in kilometres.

route.name: Route with traffic
route.description: A driving route that knows the live traffic and goes round closed roads (TomTom, the key in Igor's options), for the GPS card. Administrators only. Without a key it answers enabled: false.

heading.name: Heading
heading.description: Where the car faces, in degrees.

avoid.name: Avoid
avoid.description: Boxes to go round: [min longitude, min latitude, max longitude, max latitude].

via.name: Stops
via.description: [latitude, longitude] of stops on the way, in order.

car_go.name: Car: go to
car_go.description: Guide the car's GPS card somewhere: a place, an address, « maison » or a zone; or stop the guidance. Uses the car set in Igor's options. Administrators only. Returns where it goes, how far and how long.

query.name: Place
query.description: Where to: « maison », a zone's name, an address, a place.

name.name: Name
name.description: The name shown, with a latitude and longitude.

car_nearby.name: Car: nearby
car_nearby.description: Places of a kind the car can reach (fuel, charging, rest areas, toilets, hospital, pharmacy, ATM, supermarket, restaurant…): along the route when guided, in order, with the minutes each adds and whether it is in a motorway service area; else the nearest by road. Administrators only.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: What to look for, in a word (fuel, essence, recharge, aire, toilettes, hôpital…).

car_stop.name: Car: add a stop
car_stop.description: Add a stop on the car's way: a place of the last car_nearby answer (choice) or a position. The GPS card guides there first, then on to the destination. Administrators only.

choice.name: Choice
choice.description: Which place of the last car_nearby answer (1 = the first), instead of a latitude and longitude.
